ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: the Miasma
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
MIASMA_RM_MOD_BUILD_1 (Phase A row 19 of design/RimMandrake/biome_mod_architecture.md; parent BIOME_MOD_SPLIT_EXECUTION_1). A salt-crusted, stilt-rooted mangal forest standing in brackish channels between a dying sea and the rivers that feed it, under a green-gold haze of its own breath. Fully generalized: it names no other franchise or campaign. A separate frozen campaign world's own Miasma instance (RUT_Miasma, src/RimUtinni/UtinniPatches) is unaffected and unrelated; this is a new sibling biome for everyone else's worlds, not a rename of that one.
RM tier: nothing here knows what campaign or planet uses it.
Ships the biome and its own placement worker (RM_BiomeWorker_Miasma, replacing the donor AlphaBiomes.BiomeWorker_MiasmicMangrove — a donor type in workerClass is a hard dependency the RimMandrake tier may not assume), plus six real environmental mechanics whose C# already lives in the shared RimMandrake: Environmental Hazards Kit (mandrake.rm.environmentalhazards): a fresh-to-brine salinity gradient axis that repaints terrain over time; a breath-tide surge incident that shoves the gradient inland and lets it recede; stranding pools that leave transitional juvenile fauna behind when the tide pulls back; a permanent weather lock with a low-grade ambient exposure hediff; a small chance of a permanent "fever-forged" boon (toughened skin, hardened disease immunity, or five rarer strange-tier traits) for a pawn who survives a disease here; and warden-mother crèche placement with a despoiled-memory penalty if the warden dies. Ships 11 wildlife rows inline: two of this campaign's own invented (franchise-free) delta-loam composter and fever-swarm vector, and nine Alpha Animals/VFE Insectoids channel predators, ambushers and vermin, each individually MayRequire-gated on its own donor mod. A Mod Settings screen gives a worldgen-rarity master toggle (MOD_OPTIONS_RETROFIT_1 doctrine — default = shipped behavior, 0 = never generates); the six mechanics' own per-mechanic toggles live on the shared Environmental Hazards Kit's own settings screen, since Greentide and Sump also read those same switches — a second, Miasma-only copy of them here would either do nothing or silently diverge from what that screen already promises.
MIASMA_FLORA_ROSTER_1 replaced the donor Alpha Biomes mangal family (AB_MangroveTree/AB_ParasiticMangrove/AB_MangrovePalm, formerly 96.5% of this biome's flora weight) with 19 of this campaign's own invented RM_-tier plants: four mangals that are the biome's canopy and terrain, six always-benign rainbow blooms, a five-plant carnivorous clade that preys on the arthropod floor (never a colonist, never a tame animal), and four muck-and-silt plants naming the delta's own goods (delta salt, delta silt). sarg.alphabiomes is therefore no longer a hard modDependency — its only remaining role is the MayRequire-gated AB_FertileMud row in terrainsByFertility, an optional richer terrain when that mod happens to be present. The two invented native creatures (RUT_Karrobel, RUT_Karrathil) and the cross-mod Rot flora import (RUT_Nogtyl) still physically live in mandrake.rut.patches/mandrake.rut.rotsporekit respectively and are wired here with a fresh MayRequire guard rather than ported outright — a future pass can bring them into this mod's own tier.
NOT in this mod: the 17 genuine Star Wars wildAnimals rows (mlie.starwarsanimalcollection's Runyip/Shiro/Anooba/Grank/Whisperbird/Vornskyr/Zakkeg, and this campaign's own RSW_ ports PodWorm/CrestedDragon/MeeJuv/AaroxisDendoria/FaaJuv/LaaJuv/YobshrimpJuv/ RustNipperJuv/SiltLampreyJuv/OpeeSeaKillerJuv) the campaign roster also ratifies for this biome — those ride a Utinni patch (WildAnimals_Miasma.xml) onto this mod's own RM_Miasma def instead, per the Q11a naming-tier ruling. 5 further rows the roster itself evicted (RSW_Kreetle, Yobshrimp, RSW_Gembug, AA_BloodShrimp, AA_Plasmorph) are dropped outright, carried into neither mod.
Live proof (step 5, a scratch-world quicktest with all five expansions) is Desktop-only and OWED — see the item's own verify record.
